items.headline: TSMC announces additional $100 billion investment to build up to four more advanced fabs in Arizona, raising total U.S. commitment to $265 billion
TSMC to invest extra $100 billion in Arizona, expanding plan to 10 fabs, 2 advanced packaging facilities, and an R&D center
TSMC reports record Q2 profits with ~70% YoY jump in net profit and projects 2026 revenue growth above 40%, alongside new $100B Arizona investment plan
